test_case.test_name: Parameterized M.2 sequential-read512B QD1 sustained thermal/link validation
test_case.purpose: Measure sustained512-byte sequential-read performance and long-duration thermal/link stability on the exact approved M.2 namespace for the full source duration.
required_package: PCIe root-port generation/width, controller, power policy, filesystem/raw/cache/read-ahead state
Approved fio/libaio artifact and exact hashed job
Approval for10s ramp and43200s with composite/controller thermal, SMART/media/AER abort limits
Versioned IOPS/BW/latency thresholds, throttling policy and repetition profile
test_case.test_command: Capture M.2 namespace, canonical path, root-port/link, mounts/RAID/LVM, power/cache and health baseline; prove the target is non-OS and read-safe; validate pinned fio and the exact `rw=read`, `bs=512b`, `iodepth=1`, `numjobs=1`, `ramp_time=10s`, `runtime=43200s`, `time_based` job; run once with full output and continuous composite/controller temperature, SMART/media, AER and link-width/speed monitoring.
test_case.expected_result: The exact M.2 read profile completes for43200 seconds after ramp with zero writes/errors, no disallowed throttling or link downgrade, healthy media/controller state and every approved IOPS/BW/latency threshold met.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact namespace/topology, achieved full profile/duration, complete output, zero writes/errors, approved thermal/throttling behavior and all thresholds. Missing binding, shortened run, path drift, throttle invalidation, link downgrade or health event is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Exclude OS namespace, mounted valuable data and RAID/LVM members.
Confirm serial plus namespace/path and read-only semantics before fio.
Abort on write indication, SMART/media/AER error, link downgrade or thermal limit.
Do not substitute a short smoke test or filtered output.
expected_evidence: M.2 serial/namespace/path and root-port generation-width map
fio artifact, exact job, full output and achieved duration
Composite/controller temperature, SMART/media/AER and PCIe link timeline
Versioned thresholds, throttling assessment and final health
test_case.recovery: On path mismatch, write indication, overheating, link degradation or media error, stop without retry, preserve evidence, restore temporary cache/power state and verify namespace, PCIe link and device/host health under the approved storage procedure.
